prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Deliver one square production base-color texture for a photorealistic Korean apartment horror game asset. Reference 1 is a real 3M Korean manufacturer catalog, specifically the premium lime-yellow polyester safety vest on the upper right; reference 2 is our modeling study of that type of vest. Generate ONLY a close orthographic scan of its plain fluorescent lime-yellow knitted polyester fabric, covering the entire image edge to edge. This is a 12 cm by 12 cm swatch, so show fine regular warp-knit yarn loops with restrained real irregularity at a believable scale, subtle inter-yarn cavities and mildly worn individual fibers. Match the subdued yellow-green fabric of the real catalog, never neon glowing chartreuse. Cross-polarized, shadow-free even diffuse lighting, uniform exposure and color across the field; suitable to become an albedo texture. No garment silhouette, no folds, no logos, no printing, no borders, no reflective stripes, no seam, no staging, no gradient, no shadows, no objects, no giant mesh holes. It should look like ordinary inexpensive workwear fabric, not plastic, not procedural noise, not a dramatic macro photo. Seamless tiling on all four edges.

implementation.notes: 반사띠 경계는 재단 UV에서 계산한다. 생성 원단은 12cm 반복 간격으로 배치하고, 명암 대비와 범프 세기를 줄여 실 크기를 과장하지 않는다.
